description: Label and group Kubernetes, Helm and GitOps updates. Charts and the images they ship are grouped together, because a chart upgrade usually expects a matching image. Extend this preset after container-config so its grouping wins for images declared in Kubernetes manifests

packageRules.description: Label all Kubernetes, Helm and GitOps updates
Additionally label Helm chart updates wherever they are declared
Group non-major charts and images into one PR so a chart and the image it ships move together
Deprecated Kubernetes API versions are a manual migration, never a group member
